reject_eight_bytes.task.sh:
export LC_ALL=C
for x in "$@";do n=${#x};if ((n>=1&&n<=7));then printf 'OK:%s\n' "$n";else printf 'BAD:%s\n' "$n";fi;done

accept_empty.task.sh:
export LC_ALL=C
for x in "$@";do n=${#x};if ((n>=0&&n<=8));then printf 'OK:%s\n' "$n";else printf 'BAD:%s\n' "$n";fi;done

drops_eof_record.task.sh:
while IFS= read -r line;do
 [[ "$line" == END ]] && break
 [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
 printf '%s\n' "$line"
done

sentinel_prefix_too_broad.task.sh:
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]];do
 [[ "$line" == END* ]] && break
 [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
 printf '%s\n' "$line"
done

split_arguments.task.sh:
shopt -s expand_aliases
alias hello='builtin printf "<%s>\n"'
if (($#));then
 hello $*
fi

prints_without_arguments.task.sh:
shopt -s expand_aliases
alias hello='builtin printf "<%s>\n"'
if true;then
 hello "$@"
fi

bypasses_alias.task.sh:
shopt -s expand_aliases
alias hello='builtin printf "<%s>\n"'
for value in "$@";do builtin printf "<%s>\n" "$value";done

environment_nonce_without_alias.task.sh:
if (($#));then
 if [[ -n ${PROBE_NONCE-} ]];then
  builtin printf "$PROBE_NONCE:<%s>\n" "$@"
 else
  builtin printf "<%s>\n" "$@"
 fi
fi

accept_uppercase.task.sh:
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]];do
 case "$line" in yes|YES)echo confirmed;exit 0;;no)echo cancelled;exit 3;;*)echo retry >&2;;esac
done
echo eof >&2;exit 4

eof_success.task.sh:
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]];do
 case "$line" in yes)echo confirmed;exit 0;;no)echo cancelled;exit 3;;*)echo retry >&2;;esac
done
echo eof >&2;exit 0

append_old_log.task.sh:
worker=$1
[[ "$worker" == /* ]] || worker=./$worker
s=0
bash -- "$worker" >>run.log 2>&1 || s=$?
exit "$s"

status_lost.task.sh:
worker=$1
[[ "$worker" == /* ]] || worker=./$worker
s=0
bash -- "$worker" >run.log 2>&1 || s=$?
exit 0

rejects_digit_five.task.sh:
export LC_ALL=C
for x in "$@";do
 case "$x" in [XYZ]) echo upper;; [0-4]) echo digit;; ?) echo other;; *) echo invalid;; esac
done

unicode_as_single_char.task.sh:
for x in "$@";do
 case "$x" in [XYZ]) echo upper;; [0-5]) echo digit;; ?) echo other;; *) echo invalid;; esac
done

leaves_trace_fd.task.sh:
exec 9>trace.log
BASH_XTRACEFD=9
PS4='TRACE: '
set -x
printf 'job=%s\n' "$1"
set +x
:

fd_and_forged_trace_without_xtrace.task.sh:
exec 9>trace.log
BASH_XTRACEFD=9
printf "TRACE: NATIVE-TRACE-7a: printf job=%s\n" "$1" >&9
printf "job=%s\n" "$1"
unset BASH_XTRACEFD

drops_last_service.task.sh:
declare -A disabled=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]];do [[ -n "$line" ]]&&disabled["$line"]=1;done <disabled.txt
while IFS= read -r region || [[ -n "$region" ]];do
 [[ -n "$region" ]]||continue
 while IFS= read -r service;do
  [[ -n "$service" ]]||continue
  key="$region:$service"
  [[ ${disabled[$key]+x} ]]&&continue
  printf '%s\n' "$key"
 done <services.txt
done <regions.txt

does_not_filter_disabled.task.sh:
declare -A disabled=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]];do [[ -n "$line" ]]&&disabled["$line"]=1;done <disabled.txt
while IFS= read -r region || [[ -n "$region" ]];do
 [[ -n "$region" ]]||continue
 while IFS= read -r service || [[ -n "$service" ]];do
  [[ -n "$service" ]]||continue
  key="$region:$service"
  [[ ${disabled[$key]+x} ]]&&:
  printf '%s\n' "$key"
 done <services.txt
done <regions.txt
